separation_basis: Separate review agent; did not implement or modify the reviewed source, tests, receipts, or validation logs.
review_scope: S01 legacy recovery-map validation and compatibility
S01 metric mapping and recovery-watch behavior relevant to the recent S05/S06 changes

checks.snapshot_binding: All three supplied S01 file hashes matched the current files.
checks.legacy_one_sided_drift: The current tests cover top-level map drift and missing question-level replacement metadata; these paths flag replacement_mapping_unverified.
checks.core_summary_isolation: The recovery-watch mapping does not change the legacy core summary.
checks.combined_rewrite: Not closed: an internally consistent rewrite of both question-level replaces metadata and manifest.replacements can pass the legacy validator.

findings.title: Legacy recovery mapping can be rewritten consistently and still be trusted
evidence: scripts/question_sets.py:67 returns no authoritative metric mapping when metric_contract_version is absent.

scripts/question_sets.py:851-882 rebuilds replacements from question metadata and compares the result with manifest.replacements, but does not bind legacy question metadata to a canonical legacy release or restrict a recovery base to its intended replacement.
scripts/question_sets.py:885-915 uses the resulting mapping in recovery_watch for weak_current_ids and runway scoring.
tests/test_question_sets.py:448-474 checks one-sided top-level drift and missing metadata, but not a coordinated rewrite.

For example, changing BANK_03.replaces to include both IQS_11 and IQS_08 and changing the legacy top-level map to match can map both recovery dimensions to one answer while satisfying the current consistency and base-coverage checks.
findings.impact: The legacy core summary remains unchanged, but recovery_watch can report a misleading weakness or recovery status from the wrong mapped question.
findings.recommended_resolution: Bind legacy recovery mappings to a frozen, verifiable legacy question-set snapshot or hash; otherwise fail closed to needs_verification. Add a negative test that rewrites both mapping sources consistently and confirms the mapping is not trusted.
